subtopic: Conflicts of Interest and Fiduciary Duties
source_evidence: As fiduciaries, advisers must make full disclosure of all conflicts of interest between themselves and the funds they manage in order to get informed consent.
answer: Private equity advisers may have relationships with multiple funds, portfolio companies, or affiliated service providers, creating potential conflicts of interest. Their fiduciary duties include acting in the best interests of each fund they manage and fully disclosing conflicts so the funds can give informed consent. Investors should stay alert to conflicts that exist or may arise during the investment.
